metadata.title: Service Dependency Analysis and Startup Sequence

story.iWant: analyze service dependencies and determine startup sequence
story.soThat: services start in the correct order
story.tasks: Task 1: Service Dependency Analysis System (AC: 1) - Create service dependency graph manager, implement startup sequence calculation algorithm, add service relationship validation and circular dependency detection, create dependency visualization and reporting tools Task 2: Service Health Check Implementation (AC: 2) - Implement HTTP-based health check for backend services, create connection-based health check for database services, add process-based health check for application services, implement health check retry logic and timeout handling Task 3: Port Conflict Detection and Resolution (AC: 3) - Create port scanning and conflict detection system, implement automatic port allocation algorithm, add port conflict resolution with user confirmation, create port management configuration and persistence Task 4: Startup Timeout Management (AC: 4) - Implement configurable timeout mechanisms for each service type, add progressive timeout escalation and retry logic, create timeout monitoring and cancellation capabilities, add timeout event logging and user notification Task 5: Service Startup Configuration System (AC: 5) - Create configuration file parser and validator, implement custom startup parameter injection, add environment-specific configuration support, create configuration validation and error reporting

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Define service startup sequence: database → backend API → frontend application 2. Implement service health check mechanism, verifying service ready status 3. Detect service port conflicts, providing automatic port allocation functionality 4. Implement service startup timeout mechanism, avoiding infinite waiting 5. Create service startup configuration file, supporting custom startup parameters

doc.title: Epic Breakdown for One-Click Launch Script
doc.section: Epic 2: Service Orchestration and Startup Management
doc.snippet: Epic 2 focuses on implementing reliable service startup flow management, ensuring all services start in the correct order. Service dependency analysis and startup sequence is Story 2.1, defining the startup sequence as database → backend API → frontend application with health check mechanisms and timeout handling.

doc.title: One-Click Launch Decision Architecture
doc.snippet: Service startup sequence integration: Redis startup (port 6379) → wait for ready (30s timeout), Backend API startup (port 8000) → health check pass (60s timeout), Frontend application startup (port 3000) → build complete (120s timeout). Configuration management integration with platform-specific configs overriding defaults.

doc.title: Environment Configuration Verification
doc.section: Dev Agent Record and File List
doc.snippet: Previous story implemented ProgressTracker class at utils/progress_tracker.py with component_name parameter for progress tracking. Established service-based architecture patterns with unified error format {code, message, solution, details} and comprehensive test suite structure.

doc.title: Database Environment Configuration
doc.snippet: Database service startup patterns including Redis and PostgreSQL service detection, health check implementation, and connection validation. Service management follows platform-specific patterns for Windows services, macOS Brew services, and Linux systemd services.
